descriptions.job-1mft974:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Our EMEA Marketing team is a dynamic, fast-growing group that loves turning customers into enthusiastic Stripe advocates. We work hand-in-hand with our Sales team to build demand, help users get the most out of our products, and craft marketing plans that truly resonate with local audiences. 

In the DACH region, our team partners with some of the most ambitious innovators across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland—brands like DeepL, refurbed, N26, and Nestlé. We help them use Stripe’s financial infrastructure to unlock new revenue, navigate local complexities, and scale globally. What we learn from these relationships directly influences how Stripe builds its products. The opportunity in this region is massive. We’re tackling it as a diverse, international team that thrives on collaboration, bold innovation, and genuine curiosity. If you love to learn and want to make a meaningful impact, we'd love to have you join us.

What you’ll do

You’ll lead marketing strategy and plan execution for the DACH region and serve as the primary Marketing partner on the DACH Leadership Team. You’ll set the regional strategy and investment plan, with Germany as the main market, and shape priorities across Austria and Switzerland. You’ll be accountable for demand, pipeline, customer advocacy, and Stripe’s long-term market position in the region.

As a senior individual contributor, you will align regional and global cross-functional teams around shared priorities, secure the necessary resources, and navigate trade-offs between global strategies and local market needs. You will directly lead high-priority initiatives across the region.

Leveraging deep market and account insights, you will identify key growth opportunities across target industries and audiences. In close partnership with Sales, you will build tailored programs for strategic accounts and high-potential prospects aligned with their business models, technical environments, and commercial objectives.

Responsibilities

  • Define and own the integrated DACH marketing strategy, turning business goals, market dynamics, and competitive context into clear priorities.
  • Partner with DACH GTM leadership, Sales, Sales Development, and Partnerships to set shared priorities, join business and pipeline reviews, and focus investment on the highest-value opportunities.
  • Build and oversee a full-funnel DACH marketing plan across brand, demand generation, account-based marketing, pipeline acceleration, executive engagement, and customer advocacy.
  • Develop industry and account programs for strategic customers and high-potential prospects, helping Sales engage the right stakeholders with relevant messages.
  • Bring together EMEA and global teams, including Demand Generation and Product Marketing, to deliver the DACH plan, working with Sales, Product, Solutions Engineering, Partnerships, and Communications.
  • Build Stripe’s brand and local presence in DACH through regional customer stories, partner programs, and executive, industry, and ecosystem engagement, including activation around Stripe flagship and third-party events.
  • Own metrics across demand, pipeline, opportunity progression, priority-account engagement, and return on investment. Use results to improve programs and stop or change those that aren’t delivering.
  • Represent DACH across EMEA and global marketing teams, bringing market insight into planning and sharing successful programs across markets.

Who you are

You’re an experienced B2B marketer who has owned a country, regional, or similarly broad marketing strategy. You can set direction, make investment trade-offs, and work credibly with senior Sales and GTM leaders. You stay close enough to execution to turn the strategy into commercial results.

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements below. If you meet them, we encourage you to apply. Preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 10+ years of B2B marketing experience, including ownership of planning and investment for a country, region, or comparably broad portfolio in enterprise technology or another complex B2B environment.
  • Deep understanding of the German and wider DACH business and technology markets, including enterprise buying dynamics and local ecosystems.
  • Proven record of partnering with senior Sales and GTM leaders and aligning cross-functional teams without direct authority.
  • Experience leading integrated programs across several marketing disciplines, drawing on regional and global specialist teams.
  • Ownership of annual budgets and multi-program portfolios, with evidence of using commercial results to prioritize investment.
  • Fluency in German and English, with the ability to explain technical concepts and present complex strategies to executive audiences.
  • Sound judgment and comfort making decisions when priorities compete or information is incomplete.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in payments, financial technology, commerce, B2B cloud services, or another complex and highly competitive technology category.
  • Experience engaging enterprise executives and buying groups across Finance, Treasury, Technology, Product, and Operations.
  • A track record of building local brand relevance, thought leadership, customer advocacy, or influence strategies—not only demand-generation programs.
  • Experience building a marketing approach where the playbook, resources, or route to impact was still taking shape.
descriptions.job-1ygix1s:
About Notabene

Notabene is building infrastructure that’s transforming how money moves in the digital economy. We’re evolving beyond our compliance foundations to enable the next generation of digital financial services between regulated institutions with unprecedented efficiency. With nearly 50 employees across 14 countries and having recently closed our Series B round last November with support from leading investors including Y Combinator, DRW, F-Prime, Jump Capital, Castle Island, and Green Visor Capital, we’re looking for people like you to help shape the future rails of the crypto industry!

The Role

We're seeking a commercially minded Commercial Counsel based in Europe to work closely with and support our General Counsel, who is based in the New York City area. You'll help manage sophisticated international commercial transactions with leading global banks, financial institutions, and other multinational companies, advise internal business teams, and support the development of our legal operations and AI capabilities. This is a hands-on role requiring strong commercial judgment, technical understanding, and the ability to navigate complex legal and regulatory requirements across jurisdictions worldwide.

Where You’ll Work

This is a 100% remote role open to candidates based in Europe.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Draft, review, and negotiate complex SaaS, partnership, and other commercial agreements, including DPAs, DORA Addenda, information security exhibits, and jurisdiction-specific regulatory and outsourcing addenda.

  • Support the General Counsel in managing international commercial negotiations, while independently handling assigned contracts and projects.

  • Implement AI-powered legal tools, improve contracting workflows, and drive legal operations and process improvements.

  • Work with Security, Engineering, and other technical teams to ensure contractual commitments accurately reflect Notabene's technology, security controls, and operational practices.

  • Advise Sales, Customer Success, and other teams on commercial legal matters and prepare the agreements, templates, and other documents they need.

What You’ll Need

  • Native-level or fully fluent written and spoken English, with a track record of independently drafting and negotiating complex legal documentation in English.

  • Fully qualified lawyer in an EU jurisdiction with 3–5 years of post-qualification experience, ideally gained within top-tier law firms, fast-growing tech environments, or a mix of both.

  • Extensive experience driving end-to-end negotiations for complex enterprise technology agreements, particularly with highly regulated or global corporate clients.

  • Strong foundation in European regulatory frameworks relevant to tech companies, including data protection, privacy, and sector-specific operational/outsourcing requirements, along with the ability to adapt to international regulatory regimes.

  • A commercially minded approach to risk management - able to balance business growth with legal exposure, articulate clear risks to stakeholders, and discern strict legal/regulatory imperatives from negotiable commercial points.

  • Ability to deliver rapid turnarounds in a fast-moving startup environment, with the willingness to work flexibly across international time zones.

descriptions.job-1leffv4:
About Aspora

People on the move deserve a bank that moves with them. Since 2022, Aspora has been building a borderless financial operating system that makes money as mobile and transparent as its users.

Backed by influential venture capitalists like Sequoia Capital, Greylock Partners, Hummingbird Ventures, Y Combinator & Global Founders Capital. We're a team of 150+ across India, the UK, the UAE, EU and the US, working with extreme ownership, radical candour, and an obsession with customer impact.

We celebrate builders who question assumptions, ship fast, and turn regulatory complexity into elegant solutions. If you’re driven to redefine what global banking can be, we’d love to build the future with you.

About the Role

Aspora moves money between the EU, the UK, the UAE and India. Every corridor runs on licences, partner banks and regulators who expect security to be proven, not promised. This role is the named local owner of ICT risk, information security and IT for our EU entity — the person responsible for making our security posture provable to any regulator, auditor or partner bank, on demand.

You will own the ICT risk framework, the regulatory relationship and the certification programme, working daily with Infrastructure, DevOps and the Head of Engineering, reporting to our COO. The role is built to grow into our senior security leadership seat.

Who You Are

— You've worked in regulated financial services. You've run information security or ICT risk inside a bank, EMI, payment institution or fintech, and you've sat across from the regulator during inspections or incident notifications.
— You've closed a certification cycle. You've owned or materially run ISO 27001, SOC 2 or PCI-DSS end to end — from scoping through evidence to closing the findings.
— You speak engineer. You can read AWS access controls and a vulnerability scan, triage what matters, and have a credible technical conversation with the people who fix it.
— You've led the response. You've run incident response and DR drills hands-on, made regulatory notification calls under pressure, and stayed accountable through the post-incident fix.
— You work in Lithuanian and English. You can represent the entity to the Bank of Lithuania and partner banks in both languages, in writing and in the room.
Most importantly, you want to own the whole picture: the framework, the regulator, the certification and the engineering follow-through, for a cross-border bank that is still being built.

What You'll Own

— ICT risk and regulatory assurance. Build and run the DORA risk framework, policies, risk register and third-party register. Represent the EU entity to the Bank of Lithuania, auditors and partner banks on every IT and security matter, and close findings before they age.
— Certifications. Run the group ISO 27001 and PCI-DSS programme for the EU entity so one body of evidence serves every jurisdiction.
— Incident response and data protection. Own the incident-response playbook including the regulatory notification path, run DR and BCP drills, and be the technical counterpart to the DPO on DPIAs, transfer assessments and breach notifications.
— Engineering follow-through. Convert audit and regulatory requirements into engineering tickets with owners and dates, and follow every one to closure.
— Entity IT. Own devices, identity and access, SaaS tooling and joiner/mover/leaver for EU staff.

Why Aspora

— Define what provable security looks like for a cross-border bank — and set the standard every future entity inherits.
— Work directly with our COO and Head of Engineering, with the authority to set the bar and the support to hold it.
— Own the EU entity's regulatory relationship on security from day one, with room to grow the function as Aspora grows.
— Competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and ESOPs aligned with Aspora's long-term vision.

Location

Vilnius, Lithuania
descriptions.job-1wo6jf4:
About Dune

Dune's mission is to make onchain finance observable. We're the industry standard for onchain data: a blockchain data and intelligence provider that institutions, protocols, and analysts trust to understand the onchain world and the frontiers of finance. We deliver structured datasets, spanning stablecoins, RWAs, tokens, lending, trading, and more, from 130+ chains and counting, to 1,000+ industry leaders including Visa, WisdomTree, FINRA, the IMF, Bloomberg, Standard Chartered, Coinbase, Forbes, and the Financial Times.

We're a tight knit team of ~50 hard working people, spread across Europe and eastern US timezones 🌍️, having an outsized impact on the industry. We take pride in being ambitious and doing world class work while staying humble and lighthearted. We believe in building open, verifiable data that lets individuals and institutions do deep research into ecosystems like Ethereum, Solana, Robinhood and many more.

We're backed by some of the world's best investors. In February 2022, we announced our Series B funding round led by Coatue and Union Square Ventures, an important milestone that let us double down on our mission.

If you like being challenged and want to work together with a brilliant team on an important mission, come join us.

Learn more about us:

About Dune
https://dune.com/about

Values and working at Dune

https://dune.com/careers

About the role

Dune’s mission is to make onchain finance observable. Since 2018, we have made blockchain data accessible and useful. Our next opportunity is to build products that financial institutions depend on to commit capital, assess risk, and enter new onchain markets.

As these institutions expand their activity on blockchains, they will need reliable, trustworthy and timely data to power decision making across more markets than ever before. They will need to compare opportunities, monitor changes, and integrate data into their existing systems. For Dune these recurring needs will become a substantial and core part of our business.

We are looking for a Head of Product to help transition Dune into this new era. We will build on top of Dune’s existing data foundation, which already powers thousands of companies. You will decide which customers and use cases to serve first, which problems matter most, and which needs can become scalable products for institutional usage.

You will identify valuable customer problems and guide the company to deliver a reliable product and grow its usage.

What we are looking for

You care about markets and have a background in either traditional or onchain markets. You navigate fluently financial jargon and know how market participants use and leverage data.

You can set a clear direction, make difficult choices, and work hard through the details required to deliver. The job’s not finished with a PRD, a hire or a ticket. The job’s finished when the product is creating value in the hands of our customers, being recursively improved by tight knit relationships.

You will work closely with Dune’s engineering, data, and commercial teams while being an integral part of the leadership team. You will report to the president. Your responsibility extends from understanding a customer’s problem to delivering a product that solves it, while navigating the requirements from a large customer base.

You should be equally comfortable discussing an institution’s data requirements and deciding what the team must deliver this week.

In this role you will

  • Define the product strategy for market data and institutional customers. Decide which customers, problems, and products deserve our attention.

  • Own the product experience from data creation to delivery. Set clear requirements for coverage, accuracy, consistency, and timeliness.

  • Understand how financial institutions consume data. Turn their research, investment, trading, and operational needs into clear product priorities.

  • Work with engineering and data teams to deliver reliable datasets, data feeds, and integrations that fit customer systems.

  • Make explicit decisions about scope, quality, and delivery dates. Resolve dependencies and keep important work moving.

  • Partner with Product Marketing, Sales and other teams on customer evaluations, pricing, and adoption. Convert repeated customer needs into products we can serve at scale.

  • Define how we measure success of our products. Use the results to decide what to improve or stop.

  • Define and improve on our operational practices.

  • Leverage AI to improve our customer research, operations and feedback loops.

  • Lead and develop a product team that takes responsibility for customer results.

  • Say no and prioritize.

You might be a great fit if

  • You're excited to spend real time with customers: on calls, in their offices, learning from them.

  • You have delivered technically complex data products that customers (ideally institutional) depend on.

  • You understand market data and how financial institutions evaluate, purchase, integrate, and use it.

  • You have good knowledge of onchain markets, tokenized equities and RWAs

  • You can connect customer needs with technical requirements and a sound business case.

  • You have strong product judgment. You can make decisions with incomplete information and change them when the evidence changes.

  • You stay close to the work. You investigate problems, challenge assumptions, and help teams resolve difficult details.

  • You are known to be an excellent communicator.

  • You have startup experience, ideally a former founder or operator.



Perks & Benefits

  • A competitive salary and equity package 🚀. Both salary and equity is top 25% of companies in the space

  • Our employee equity scheme has world-class employee-friendly terms with a heavily discounted strike price (~90%) and a 10-year exercise window

  • 5 weeks PTO + local public holidays (that can be swapped to suit you) 🏖

  • A fully remote-first approach 🧑‍💻 within a distributed team with flexible working hours; you structure your own day 

  • Say goodbye to meeting overload! We believe in a healthy mix of async and sync work, so you can focus on what truly matters—no more wasted time on endless meetings!

  • Good health is important, so we offer private medical insurance, dental & vision as standard 🩺

  • We believe in paid parental leave 👶 to help you celebrate this important milestone, transition to your new life, and bond with your new baby. We offer 16 weeks to primary and 6 weeks to secondary caregivers, fully paid. Plus a 2-week part-time phased return at full pay to help you get used to your new (and slightly more complex!) schedule

  • Quarterly offsites in various exciting locations as a company or team to connect, work together and have fun (so far in Tuscany 🇮🇹 Berlin 🇩🇪 Austria 🇦🇹 and Athens 🇬🇷).

  • On top of this 👆each person gets a yearly travel allowance to connect and co-work with someone or a team of people for a few days.

  • An allowance for your at-home setup, to ensure you are happy, comfortable and productive. If you prefer a local co-working space, we’ll pay for your desk.

  • An annual allowance for your Learning and Development needs.

  • Work with some of the best people you’ll ever get to meet!

  • And of course, you get some awesome Dune swag! ✌️😎

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
descriptions.job-1voxus0:
Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose of economic empowerment. The blocks that form our foundational teams — People, Finance, Counsel, Hardware, Information Security, Platform Infrastructure Engineering, and more — provide support and guidance at the corporate level. They work across business groups and around the globe, spanning time zones and disciplines to develop inclusive People policies, forecast finances, give legal counsel, safeguard systems, nurture new initiatives, and more. Every challenge creates possibilities, and we need different perspectives to see them all. Bring yours to Block.

The Role

Block’s Business Platform Engineering organization powers the foundational systems that support financial operations across Square, Cash App, TIDAL, and Proto. We are building the next generation of financial and supply chain infrastructure that enables accurate reporting, operational efficiency, regulatory compliance, and strategic decision-making across Block.

As an Engineering Manager in Finance & Supply Chain Engineering, you will lead a team of engineers building mission-critical systems across areas such as Record-to-Report automation, financial planning and forecasting, tax and regulatory reporting, and supply chain planning and execution.

This is a unique opportunity to help shape a mostly greenfield team and platform from the ground up. You will help build agentic systems that run the business — systems that automate workflows, reason across financial and operational data, assist decision-making, and make critical business processes more efficient, reliable, and scalable.

You will have influence across the full spectrum: team culture, engineering practices, technical strategy, product direction, architecture, and implementation. You will be responsible for building and supporting a high-performing engineering team, shaping technical strategy, partnering closely with Finance, Accounting, Tax, Compliance, Product, and Operations stakeholders, and ensuring the team delivers reliable, scalable, and well-governed systems.

You Will

  • Lead and grow an engineering team: Manage, coach, and develop engineers across a range of experience levels; create clarity, accountability, and growth opportunities for the team.
  • Shape a greenfield platform: Help define the foundations for a new generation of financial and supply chain systems, including the team’s operating model, technical patterns, delivery practices, and long-term architecture.
  • Build agentic systems that run the business: Lead the development of intelligent, automated systems that streamline financial operations, coordinate business workflows, improve decision-making, and reduce manual operational burden.
  • Set technical direction: Partner with engineering leads and cross-functional stakeholders to define architecture, roadmap, and execution plans for financial and supply chain systems.
  • Drive execution: Translate ambiguous business needs into clear technical priorities, delivery plans, and measurable outcomes.
  • Partner cross-functionally: Work closely with Finance, Accounting, Tax, Compliance, Product, and Operations teams to understand business processes and build systems that support critical workflows.
  • Ensure reliability and operational excellence: Hold the team accountable for building well-tested, observable, secure, and resilient systems that support high-stakes financial operations.
  • Navigate complexity: Help the team make pragmatic decisions across legacy systems, integrations, data pipelines, regulatory requirements, agentic workflows, and evolving business needs.
  • Build engineering culture: Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-ownership team environment with strong engineering practices, healthy code review, documentation, and incident learning.
  • Develop people and leaders: Provide coaching, feedback, performance management, and career development for engineers; identify and grow future technical leaders

You Have

  • 12+ years of software engineering experience, including 4+ years of experience leading or managing engineers.
  • Experience serving in a technical leadership role with responsibility for delivery, execution, and team health.
  • Strong technical judgment and the ability to guide architecture and design decisions across distributed systems, data-intensive applications, automation platforms, or business-critical systems.
  • Interest in building intelligent or agentic systems that automate complex workflows, improve decision-making, and help teams operate more effectively.
  • Experience partnering with non-technical stakeholders and translating complex business requirements into clear engineering priorities.
  • A track record of delivering reliable, well-tested, and maintainable systems in production.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to create alignment across engineering, product, finance, compliance, and operations teams.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguous domains where business process, regulatory requirements, and technical systems intersect.
  • A strong desire to build healthy teams, grow engineers, influence culture, and shape strategy from early-stage ideas through implementation

Technologies We Use and Teach

You do not need to have experience with every technology listed below, but familiarity with modern application, data, automation, and infrastructure patterns will help you be successful.

  • Languages: Go, Ruby, JavaScript / TypeScript
  • Frameworks: Ruby on Rails, React
  • Databases: MySQL, Snowflake
  • Infrastructure: AWS, S3, Aurora, Docker
  • Orchestration: Temporal, Prefect
  • Testing: Unit tests, integration tests, RSpec, Vitest
  • Monitoring: Datadog, Sentry
  • Protocols: HTTP, JSON, gRPC
  • Emerging systems: Agentic workflows, AI-assisted automation, business process orchestration

descriptions.job-04eff2o:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

The Crypto Perpetuals team is building Robinhood’s advanced trading experience for customers who want fast, intuitive access to crypto derivatives markets. Our team powers the mobile workflows that help traders monitor price action, understand market depth, manage risk, and place trades with confidence in rapidly moving markets.

We work at the intersection of high-performance UI, real-time market data, and complex trading systems. From responsive charting and order entry to position management and risk-aware product experiences, our work directly shapes how active traders engage with Robinhood’s crypto platform.

As a Senior iOS Engineer on the Crypto Perpetuals team, you’ll design and build performant mobile experiences that support real-time data, sophisticated trading flows, and highly reliable execution. You’ll partner closely with product, design, and backend engineering to deliver intuitive tools for serious traders, while helping raise the technical bar across the team through strong architecture, execution, and mentorship.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA OR New York, NY office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you'll do

  • 6+ years of professional experience developing iOS applications
  • Design and implement scalable iOS application architecture that supports advanced crypto trading experiences used by Robinhood's most active investors
  • Partner with product managers, designers, backend engineers, and data teams to deliver fast, reliable, and intuitive pro-grade trading tools on mobile
  • Improve application performance, real-time data handling, observability, and release stability across core crypto trading workflows
  • Lead technical planning and provide guidance during system design reviews, implementation discussions, and incident resolution efforts for high-stakes trading features
  • Mentor iOS engineers through code reviews, technical feedback, and structured development support while contributing to engineering standards and documentation

What you bring

  • Extensive experience building and maintaining large-scale iOS applications using Swift and modern iOS development frameworks
  • Experience designing mobile systems with clear architecture patterns, scalable component design, and maintainable testing strategies — particularly for data-intensive or real-time use cases
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with product, design, backend, and infrastructure partners to deliver customer-focused technical solutions
  • Experience leading technical initiatives across multiple teams and balancing short-term delivery needs with long-term platform improvements
  • Experience working on financial platforms, trading systems, or real-time market data products (preferred)
  • Clear communication skills and ability to translate complex trading concepts into intuitive mobile experiences
  • This position is restricted to US citizens or lawful permanent residents

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career
  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching
  • Best in class benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents
  • Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more
  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits.

About the Job

zerohash's Applied AI team manages two fronts: an internal Intelligence Core (a system connectivity and control layer) and external agentic-commerce products. This role acts as the engineering backbone for both—building the access layer, audit logging, skills/agents, and system architecture. The Applied AI team builds the Intelligence Core itself. Engineering maintains platform accounts, event hooks, and retrieval layers; this role builds everything above them.

Core objective: Connect company systems securely, and produce records of agent action that a third party can verify.

Strategic importance: The internal build acts as a sandbox for agentic commerce products. Identity, authority, write permissions, and tamper-evident logging will be proven internally before powering multi-institutional agentic networks.

Responsibilities

  • Own the access layer (native connectors, MCP servers, Databricks US/EU) using short-lived tokens, least-privilege read-only access, and zero raw PII while enforcing data residency.
  • Define a versioned schema for two signed record types of credentials and action records, in one namespace so each can be checked against the other.
  • Establish build discipline early: deployment pipelines, authority policy as code, skill merge gates, and signed builds with SBOMs.
  • Build the authority lease service with integrated kill switches.
  • Capture events into append-only, hash-chained logs for tamper-evident and independently verifiable auditing.
  • Migrate the team’s existing agents onto the Core, launch new per-department agents and lead security reviews for continuous read access.
  • Extend the Core from read to bounded write: logged actions, idempotency keys, compensating actions, and multi-approver time-locks for anything that moves money.
  • Design core primitives for cross-institution interoperability, wrapping actions in signed mandates, scoped authority, and attestation receipts compatible with standards like x402, AP2, and MPP.
  • Design self-hosted, zero-egress private stacks when required by classification evidence.
  • Evaluate and integrate state-of-the-art developments in agent frameworks, confidential inference, and zero-knowledge attestations.
  • Maintain a security-first posture by threat-modeling prompt injection, credential exfiltration, and confused-deputy risks upfront.

Requirements

  • Senior, Python-first backend engineering with production experience in event-driven systems, API integration, and CI/CD.
  • Agent-system experience — composing LLM agents (Claude, GPT, or comparable; Bedrock or comparable platforms) into standing systems — with the judgment to keep the models at the edges and the control plane deterministic.
  • Demonstrate security-first habits in a regulated environment (MSB/VASP, bank, or comparable): least privilege and read-only as reflexes, not requirements to be reminded of.
  • Working familiarity with capability-based authorization: attenuable tokens, workload identity, policy-as-code.

Preferred

  • Verifiable credentials, HTTP message signatures, or any of the emerging agent-payment mandate schemes (x402, AP2, MPP, Visa TAP, Mastercard Agent Pay).
  • Self-hosted LLM stacks; confidential computing / trusted execution environments.
  • A research habit and autonomy: this is a foundational seat on a new team, with wide scope and few hand-holds.

Benefits

  • Healthcare Insurance: zerohash covers roughly 100% of employee premiums as well as a portion of spouse/children (U.S. only)
  • Vision & Dental Insurance (U.S. only)
  • Chance to earn equity
  • Maternity & Paternity leave (after 6 months)
  • WeWork All Access Membership
  • WFH Yearly Stipend
  • L&D Yearly Stipend (after 6 months)

About zerohash

zerohash is the leading crypto and stablecoin infrastructure platform and the operating system for digital money, powering the next generation of financial services. Founded in 2017, zerohash enables banks, brokerages, fintechs, and payment companies to offer crypto trading, stablecoin payments, and tokenized assets without having to build or manage complex blockchain infrastructure on their own.

The zerohash platform supports three core pillars: Trade, Transact, and Tokenize. Through a single integration, customers can launch regulated crypto buy, sell, and custody services; enable 24/7 stablecoin-based funding, payouts, and settlement; and issue and manage tokenized assets with built-in compliance, risk controls, and reporting. By abstracting away technical, regulatory, and operational complexity, zerohash allows partners to treat digital assets as just another financial primitive: fast, programmable, and global.

zerohash is trusted by some of the world’s most recognized financial and consumer brands, including Interactive Brokers, Morgan Stanley, Stripe, Franklin Templeton, BlackRock, DraftKings, Gusto, Worldpay, Kalshi, One Pay, among others. Today, zerohash infrastructure supports millions of end users across brokerage, wealth, payments, and marketplace platforms globally.

The company is deeply regulated and compliance-first, operating across the U.S. and internationally with licenses and approvals that allow partners to enter crypto and stablecoins with confidence. zerohash has become a trusted partner for enterprises seeking to modernize financial products while meeting the highest standards for security, risk management, and regulatory oversight.

zerohash has been featured in top-tier media outlets such as Bloomberg, CNBC, The Wall Street Journal, Financial Times, Reuters, Forbes, and CoinDesk, and its leadership team regularly contributes to global conversations on the future of payments, investing, and financial infrastructure.

At zerohash, we're building the infrastructure that makes digital money work securely, compliantly, and at global scale.

  • Independence/Ownership - An ability to work autonomously. Join zerohash, pitch ideas, and shape the work you do.

Product Manager - Exchange Product

AI Engineer — Internal Tools & Automation

The AI Engineering team acts as an internal catalyst. We identify where the business is slow, build tools to fix it, and move on. Our work spans Customer Success, Exchange Operations, Trading, and Custody — wherever there's friction worth eliminating.


This isn't a research role. We ship fast, measure impact, and iterate. You'll spend more time prototyping with LLMs and building agentic workflows than writing infrastructure, but you'll own what you build all the way to production.

What You'll Do

  • Partner with a business counterpart to identify and scope operational bottlenecks, then build the tools to fix them
  • Move autonomously across the organization: gather requirements, secure data access, and earn the trust of teams you're helping
  • Ship quickly using whatever fits: n8n, Make, Zapier, Lovable, or custom Python. Right tool for the right job.
  • Build and maintain production AI systems: RAG pipelines, conversational interfaces, workflow automation, internal agents
  • Run workshops and training sessions to help non-technical teams actually use what you build
  • Define metrics upfront, track them, and tell the story of what changed

What We're Looking For

We care more about what you've shipped than where you worked. Show us:

  • A portfolio of things you've built. Personal projects, side tools, public demos, anything you can point at. GitHub, a writeup, a Loom walkthrough, a live URL. All count.
  • Evidence you move fast with LLMs. You've run multiple coding agents in parallel and know how to coordinate between them. You have a feel for how capable frontier models actually are, and you match model intelligence to task complexity rather than defaulting to the biggest one every time.
  • Production instincts. You've dealt with the gap between "it works in the demo" and "it works at 3am when nobody's watching." Evals, error handling, observability. You've thought about this.
  • A process-driven mindset. You document how things work before someone asks you to. Your SOPs and checklists aren't overhead — they're how you stay sharp and move fast without dropping things.
  • You've always had ideas. Now you can ship them. AI coding agents removed the bottleneck that used to sit between your thinking and working software. You don't wait for an engineer to build what you've already figured out.
  • Communication that closes the gap. You can translate what you built into terms that matter to the business partner who asked for it.
  • Formal experience: 5+ years in a role where you shipped tools that people actually used.
